edge_explainer: Ruling: a genuine consolidated DE-RATE wrapped around a real, disclosed, segment-level DERAILMENT confined to ~23% of revenue. Cause is fully read from primary sources: an AI-disruption narrative de-rate that was sector-wide in Jan-Feb 2026 (Feb-3 -10.9% on a CNBC-documented software-wide AI-fear day, no company news), then name-specific from April, then validated by management's own May-20 actions (-20.0% on 22.4M shares). Consolidated estimates are RISING, not falling: audited 9-month FY26 XBRL shows revenue +14.0%, GAAP operating income +18.0%, operating cash flow +28.8%, and FY26 guidance was raised twice and never cut. That is the HUBS/CTSH/SAP winner signature at the total-company level. HONESTY FINDING (mid-grade, spin not fraud): the May-20 headline read 'Raises Full-Year Revenue Guidance' while TurboTax -- the one franchise the entire bear thesis concerns -- was CUT from 8% to ~7% for the first time all year, in the quarter containing the completed US tax season; the aggregate raise was funded by Credit Karma going 10-13% to ~19%. This is the BAH-Civil segment-flooring pattern: an aggregate floor hiding mix erosion. Intuit DID disclose the underlying data in the same release (Online units -2%, e-file share -1pt, pay-nothing 8M to 7M), so it is not an ELEVATE, and the market repriced it -20% the next session, so it yields NO honesty alpha -- its forward value is that management's aggregate framing cannot be taken at face value into Aug-20. SBC CORRECTION: the bulls' '13.3x forward' is a non-GAAP artifact -- 3.08B of add-backs equal 14.4% of revenue, FY25 SBC was 10.4% of revenue, and diluted WASO was 283M in both FY22 and FY25, meaning ~8.6B of buybacks retired ~0.4% net. The honest multiple is ~16x EV/FCF-after-SBC or 20x GAAP EPS, which SOFTENS but does not refute the queue's cheapness premise. Partly rehabilitating: SBC intensity is falling (9.9% to 9.1% of revenue), the share count is now genuinely shrinking (-1.9% in 9 months), and the 8B authorization is worth 9.2% of shares at 317 versus 4.5% at 650 -- the de-rate doubled the buyback's accretion power, and buybacks ran +65% YoY. CAP STRUCTURE pulled BEFORE any EV claim (424B5 2026-06-08): no preferred issued, no convertibles, no warrants; 7,950M principal debt pro forma versus ~8.54B cash+investments = net cash +0.59B; the June 1.75B raise (4.950% 2031 + 5.500% 2036) is a refinancing of the 2026/2027 notes, not a hole-filler. AI-BREAK CONFLICT, courted as the conflict: INTU's exposure runs OPPOSITE to the capex-cycle names. The AI-WINS leg (p=0.55) HURTS INTU -- the named bear is an AI-WINS-world casualty. The AI-BREAK leg (p=0.45) HELPS INTU. The entry therefore does NOT require the cycle holding; it is a partial hedge for a household already ~5.2M/26% long AI-WINS. But the hedge is IMPERFECT and is not overclaimed: an actual capex bust compresses all software multiples (INTU fell 10.9% on Feb-3 purely as software beta), and a recession hits SMB formation and Credit Karma's credit-lead-gen economics -- exactly the 77% currently carrying the thesis. AI-BREAK helps the narrative axis and hurts the beta and SMB-cyclical axes. CLASSIFICATION is RISK_PREMIUM, not EDGE: the decisive question -- will LLMs commoditize DIY tax prep and SMB bookkeeping -- has no verification path against any filing, satellite, customs record, or docket, so the +21.4pp is compensation for unresolvable uncertainty, not payment for a mispriced fact. Solving the scenario set at 317.05 implies the tape carries p(bear) ~0.52 against our 0.30; that gap IS the entire return and it rests on the unverifiable. Fairness is verified, tails are bounded and unlevered, the sleeve is capped, and this is carry -- labeled. TOP UNVERIFIABLE: the terminal DIY-tax question itself.
